name: helper-source-folders
goal: Public helpers live under src/helpers/<responsibility> and helper Source tabs show only the selected callable implementation; owner-private helpers stay with owners

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Pre-existing mixed helper/module ownership survived71 structural moves. Humanize was defined under utils but its module owned component contract code; helperEntity narrowed owns.source but retained all archived sourceFiles.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing Source fixture had one effective source per helper and no selected-helper archive assertion. Registry checked examples but not canonical helper ownership. Pieces test allowed helper classes. Extended these standard checks and generated-project guidance coverage.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable red f67c87d9 fails the helper source, scaffold, generated guidance and selected-source assertions on this exact unfixed commit.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Extract all10 pure helpers to categorized helper files; retain IDs and compatibility exports; enforce source ownership and scaffold pure functions; narrow selected archives.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: 1858be66b extracts the actual unchanged implementations and updates active callers, registry and guidance. e87fa6792 preserves one compact compatibility import.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Immutable green dc728917 passes the same frozen tests and environment as red f67c87d9. It retains9 screenshots and40 observations on this exact fix commit.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated fixture removal of helperSources validation fails; restoration passes. /tmp/harness-helper-folders-guard.json has negativeExit1 and restoredExit0; used bundled Node for stable esbuild startup.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: Root42 focused cases/types/lint/build/audit, Reports690 cases/types/lint/build plus final audit follow-up, Hub/Desktop types and24 Source browser cases pass. Retained red/green pixels inspected. CLI/native deferred; final same-tree capture and managed-main readback remain delivery checks.
